steps.action: On the old version, do "Member picks who reads the message" up to step 1; update the app; open it and carry on.
user_sees: The journey carries on or starts again cleanly, with nothing lost that was saved
must_not: A crash on first open, a lost or half-saved Member-to-gym message thread, or a step that the new version no longer understands

note: Older apps send without a recipient: old rule

steps.action: At "Who should read it?" pick a trainer by name; type and send
user_sees: The message shows it went to that trainer

user_sees: The other side shows the same facts, in its own words
must_not: The member and the gym seeing different facts about the Member-to-gym message thread, or the member seeing what only the gym may see

start: Member app, Gym tab, Message your gym, Question; set-up: emoji in text

steps.action: Put emoji into the name or note used by "Member picks who reads the message".

user_sees: The message shows it went to that trainer
must_not: A failed save with no message, or a broken Member message line in a list, a message, an export or a receipt

start: Member app, Gym tab, Message your gym, Question; set-up: longest name or text

steps.action: Use the longest allowed name or text for Member message line (a 60-letter name, a 500-letter note), then do "Member picks who reads the message".
user_sees: The text wraps or is cut with dots; every button can still be reached
must_not: Text over other text, a button pushed off the screen, or the Member message line saved with its text cut without a word to the user

steps.action: At "Who should read it?" pick a trainer by name; type and send
user_sees: The message shows it went to that trainer
must_not: Text over other text, a button pushed off the screen, or the Member message line saved with its text cut without a word to the user

steps.action: At "Who should read it?" pick a trainer by name; type and send
user_sees: The message shows it went to that trainer

steps.action: Tap the main button of step 1 of "Member picks who reads the message" twice, fast.
user_sees: One result; the button shows it is busy
must_not: Two rows of Member-to-gym message thread, two charges, two messages sent, or two screens opened

note: Two taps count as two sends within limits

must_not: A lost Member-to-gym message thread, a double Member-to-gym message thread after the retry, or a success message for a save that failed

note: Two taps count as two sends within limits
